method: Unique full Git commit identities reachable from the scanned application branch and worktree heads, including merge commits, bucketed by UTC committer date. No test, acceptance or merge-status filter.

scope.description: Captured local application integration and implementation branches, locally recorded remote-tracking branches and existing registered worktrees in two Git stores, plus all 453 live remote application branch heads. Full commit identities are unioned across these sources.
scope.excluded: Website repository, uncommitted changes, reflog/stash/tag/archive-only refs, automated checkout-only snapshot objects, backup-only refs and missing-worktree-only heads. Earlier unavailable local repositories are not covered.

qualification: Committed source activity, including untested and unmerged work, not feature completion, test passes or deployed releases. The final day is partial through the stated cutoff. Work without a reachable commit is excluded.
coverage: Lower bound for the explicitly scanned local and live remote refs. November 5–14 counts are not established; dated work is shown instead of zero or empty bars. Other unavailable repositories may contain additional commits.
